name: intent-engineering
description: Intent controller, eight composable operators, and five executable ratchet skills for evidence-driven reliable software work.

interface.shortDescription: Run intent-driven work through the smallest sufficient evidence-backed loop
interface.longDescription: A controller and eight composable operators for moving from intent to evidence-backed, verified, validated change, plus executable ratchet skills that convert recurring engineering lessons into repository-owned constraints.
defaultPrompt: Take this through the smallest sufficient intent-engineering loop.
Use $intent on this task and keep progress evidence-backed.
Verify and validate this change, then capture any durable learning.
Learn from this failure and ratchet the repository so the same class of mistake is harder to repeat.
